text:
Nina: FYI — MoneyDesk wants a 10-day POC but with strict EU-only processing for EU tenants (inference, logs, model artifacts). No US sub-processors for those tenants.
Diego: Understood. Do we have a customer-ready subprocessor list with SOC2/ISO links? Legal asked for vendor cert chains.
Claire: We have a matrix but it's internal. Quick infra notes: EU primary is Frankfurt (GCP), DR in Amsterdam (Azure). Some observability vendors default to US endpoints (Datadog, Honeycomb).
Nina: They said any telemetry to US is a deal-breaker. Can we run a POC that guarantees zero US egress?
Diego: Yes if we run Dedicated or Private and disable external agents. Hosted public tier uses control-plane services in US, so it won't meet the "no-US" requirement without exceptions.
Claire: Minimal POC config we use for EU-only:
```
routing_policy: REGION_PIN_EU
telemetry: EXTERNAL_DISABLED
excluded_subprocessors: [datadog, honeycomb, sentry]
kms_region: europe-west1
allow_cross_border_failover: false
```
Nina: Good. Pricing delta? They expect Hosted credits but Dedicated needed to meet residency.
Diego: Rough estimate: ~€4k-6k for a 10-day EU-dedicated POC with 2 GPUs and ops support. Private (customer VPC + KMS) adds a setup fee.
Claire: I'll assemble the subprocessor matrix and tag vendors as EU-hosted / US-only / excluded. Will include SOC2/ISO links where available. ETA EOD.
Nina: Can we commit in writing that requests won't be routed to US during the POC?
Diego: Yes — we can add a clause: "During the POC term Redwood will enforce EU region pinning and exclude listed sub-processors; no automatic cross-border processing will occur without prior written consent."
ops-bot: Ticket INFRA-9124 created for EU-dedicated POC provisioning (ETA 4 business days). Follow-up reminder set for 72h.
Nina: I'll send the two options to the customer: 1) Hosted (fast, can't meet EU-only) 2) EU Dedicated (meets ask, higher cost, 4-5 day lead). Attach draft clause + subproc matrix when ready.
Diego: If customer pushes on cost, offer a partial credit for feedback and a longer eval.
Claire: Looping in legal & solutions-eng after I upload the matrix.
Nina: Great — I'll reply to MoneyDesk with options and timelines. :thumbsup:
